title: Canary probe chain for VPC post-upgrade health validation and model warm-start checks
creator: Priya Nair
description: Background: After recent Private (VPC) control plane and runtime upgrades we've seen intermittent service regressions that only appear under realistic traffic and model-hosting sequences. Purpose: implement a lightweight canary probe chain that runs automatically post-deploy (or post-upgrade) to validate API readiness, exercise model lazy-load paths, and exercise KV cache warm-start and eviction flows. This ticket covers the automation harness, Terraform outputs integration, health scoring, and a small set of golden-model test scenarios (small/medium/long sequences) to detect regressions before routing production traffic.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible canary probe chain runs automatically from the deployment orchestration step and reports a single pass/fail health score to the deployer dashboard

Probe chain includes: API handshake (auth + ping), short chat generation (10 tokens), medium generation (512 tokens), model load memory check, KV cache warm-start touch, and model eviction/reload verification
Failure modes are actionable: probe logs include GRPC/HTTP status, model loader traces, memory pressure snapshot, and a suggested mitigation (retry, revert, scale-up, or skip-canary)
Terraform module exposes outputs required to target the instance group and temporary canary credentials (ttl) for the harness
Integration tests added to CI that simulate a failed model load and verify the canary returns non-zero exit code and posts a deployment annotation
Runbook created in Confluence with troubleshooting steps and links to the canary logs and revert workflow
steps: Add canary probe job to post-deploy Terraform module: module.private.deploy -> module.post_deploy_canary
Canary job bootstraps a short-lived service account via IaC outputs; TTL 15m by default

Sequence: 1) API handshake (GET /v1/health and token auth), 2) POST /v1/chat with 1-turn prompt (10 tokens) to validate stream path, 3) POST /v1/generate with 512-token request to exercise compilation paths, 4) Trigger a model load of a medium-sized image model (golden-model: redwood/gold-compat-7b) with warm-start KV touch, 5) Force eviction by allocating small synthetic pressure and re-request the model to validate reload latency
Collect runtime metrics during probe: peak RSS, GPU memory allocation, kernel selection logs, KV cache hits/misses, compilation cache hits
Health scoring: assign weighted scores for API (20%), short-gen (15%), mid-gen (30%), model-load (25%), reload-latency (10%); fail if score < 0.85
Expose canary result as a Terraform output and as a deployment annotation to the console (POST to console internal endpoint)
metrics: API handshake latency < 150ms (p50) under canary network conditions
Short-gen end-to-end latency < 200ms (including auth and streaming handshake)
Mid-gen throughput: 512 tokens completed within 1200ms p50 on dedicated-1x config
Model load cold-start < 3s for gold-compat-7b on current runtime profile
Reload latency (after forced eviction) < 1.2x cold-start baseline
KV cache warm-touch hit rate >= 70% for prefix pattern used by probe
